channel.title: Degreed incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Degreed's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Sitewide Slowness - US Region [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved, and site performance has returned to normal.
A Root Cause Analysis is currently in progress and will be published in the Knowledge Center by the end of the week. Customers with open support tickets related to this incident will be notified once it is available.

item.title: Login Issues on Degreed Web (US) [resolved]
item.description: The US Degreed platform has been fully restored. Our engineering team implemented a fix to our underlying infrastructure, and we will continue to closely monitor the systems to ensure ongoing stability. A full root cause analysis will be shared in the coming days. We are grateful for your patience and apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: Search Intermittent Degradation [resolved]
item.description: Search has been restored to full performance. Our team has completed the necessary mitigation steps and the system is stable. We will continue to monitor closely to ensure everything remains healthy. Thank you for your patience throughout this incident.

item.title: Search Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description:
Search Performance and Integration Data Sync
We’re pleased to share that Degreed Search services have been fully restored, and Search functionality is now operating at normal performance levels. Our engineering teams will continue to actively monitor service health to ensure ongoing stability.
Also, all remaining integration data that was queued in our database has now been successfully synced therefore all content, user, and learning information is fully up to date.
This will be our final message on this issue, and we sincerely appreciate your continued patience and understanding throughout the resolution process. For any related questions, please reach out to our Support team or your Account Director.

item.title: Zendesk Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: The Zendesk issue caused by the Cloudflare outage has now been resolved and all services are operating normally.

item.title: Search Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue affecting search performance. Response times and result consistency have returned to normal. We continue to monitor closely for any anomalies to ensure full stability.

item.title: Login issues with US and CA production environments [resolved]
Content catalog (end user, admin) are not loading [resolved]
item.description: Resolved: The issue has been fully resolved, and all systems are now operating normally.

item.title: Login and SSO failures [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Users in all regions should now be able to log in successfully via SSO.

item.title: In-App Reports Unable to Generate [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. Please note that pending reports are still processing and may take 12–24 hours to fully complete. We appreciate your patience.
